title: Power of attorney
summary: Learn about making a power of attorney to help manage your affairs if you are unable to do so yourself.
who_can_apply: You must be able to make the power of attorney yourself.
what_you_need: A trusted person to act as your attorney.
Understanding the different types of decisions you want to cover (financial, property, personal care).

internal_links.text: Get started making a Power of Attorney

faqs.q: What is a power of attorney?
faqs.a: A power of attorney allows you to appoint someone to make decisions for you if you are unable to do so yourself.

faqs.q: Who can be appointed as an attorney?
faqs.a: You can appoint anyone you trust to be your attorney.

faqs.q: What types of decisions can a power of attorney cover?
faqs.a: A power of attorney can cover decisions about your finances, property, and personal care.
